mechanism_of_action: Dual agonist of the glucagon receptor and GLP-1 receptor.
primary_endpoint: At 48 weeks, histologic improvement in MASH (reduction) with no worsening of fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint occurred in 47%, 62%, and 43% with survodutide 2.4, 4.8, and 6.0 mg, respectively, versus 14% with placebo (P<0.001 for the quadratic dose-response curve).
safety_signal: Nausea occurred in 66% vs 23%, diarrhea in 49% vs 23%, and vomiting in 41% vs 4% with survodutide versus placebo; serious adverse events occurred in 8% vs 7%.
